issues.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gel)
issues.sym: Blue smoke from the tailpipe, oil level dropping between changes, a check engine light, or in bad cases the oil pressure light with ticking or knocking.
issues.why: Oil in this V6 could thicken into gel or sludge, most often when oil changes were stretched out. The sludge blocks oil passages and starves the engine. Toyota set up a support program and later a class settlement for affected engines.
issues.next: Stop driving if the oil pressure light comes on. Have the engine checked for sludge under the oil filler cap and keep oil changes on a short schedule.

issues.t: Brake booster hose can freeze in severe cold (recall)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal and longer stopping distances on very cold days.
issues.why: Moisture could collect and freeze inside the vacuum hose that feeds the brake booster, cutting power assist. Toyota recalled the cars to fix the hose.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the pedal feels hard in the cold, drive gently and get it repaired before relying on the car.

issues.t: Theft-deterrent wiring connector faults (recall)
issues.sym: Dash lights, the heater and A/C, or the engine acting up or cutting out at random.
issues.why: Faulty terminals in the theft-deterrent wiring harness could lose contact and open circuits that other systems rely on. Toyota recalled the cars to repair the connectors.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the recall repair was done, especially if lights or accessories cut in and out.

issues.t: Rear axle may be too weak (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. A failing part may cause clunking, wobbling or a change in how the rear of the car tracks.
issues.why: Some rear axle parts were not heat-treated correctly at the factory and could break over time. Toyota recalled the cars to replace them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it done. Stop driving and have it towed if the rear of the car starts clunking or wandering.

issues.t: Front subframe welds may fail (recall)
issues.sym: Clunks or creaks from the front end over bumps, or vague steering, as a weak weld starts to give way.
issues.why: Some front subframes were not welded well enough at the factory and could crack with long-term use. Toyota recalled the cars to inspect and fix them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Have the front end inspected right away if you hear new clunks.

issues.t: Steering lock bar can crack and lock the wheel (recall)
issues.sym: The steering wheel lock may stick or bind when you turn the key, and in rare cases the wheel could lock.
issues.why: The steering lock bar was cast poorly and could crack and eventually break, which could leave the steering wheel locked. Toyota recalled the cars to replace it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it fixed. Do not drive the car if the steering lock is acting up.

issues.t: Airbag control module may fail (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on. In rare cases airbags or seat belt pretensioners could fire without a crash.
issues.why: The airbag control module could fail and send a false signal to deploy. Toyota recalled the cars to fix the module.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it repaired promptly. Have the airbag light diagnosed if it is on.

issues.t: Crankshaft pulley can let the power steering belt come off (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly gets very heavy, sometimes with a slapping or squealing noise from the engine bay.
issues.why: Too little adhesive was used on part of the crankshaft pulley, so it could shift and throw the belt that drives the power steering pump. Toyota recalled the cars to replace the pulley.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the steering turns heavy, pull over safely and have the car towed.

issues.t: VVT oil line can burst
issues.sym: A sudden oil leak or spray, oil smoke from under the hood, a low oil pressure light, or a puddle of oil under the car.
issues.why: Part of the oil line that feeds the variable valve timing system was made of rubber, which could age and split. Toyota ran a limited service campaign to swap it for an all-metal line.
issues.next: Shut the engine off right away if the oil pressure light comes on. Ask a dealer whether the all-metal line has been installed on your car.

issues.t: Water pump leaks
issues.sym: Pink coolant drips near the front of the engine, a sweet smell, a low coolant level, or the temperature gauge climbing.
issues.why: The water pump seal and bearing on this V6 wear out with age and mileage. Earlier engines were more prone to it before an updated pump arrived.
issues.next: Top up coolant and get the pump replaced soon. Stop driving if the temperature gauge climbs toward hot.

issues.t: Dashboard cracks or turns sticky
issues.sym: The top of the dash gets soft, sticky, shiny or cracked and throws glare onto the windshield.
issues.why: The dashboard material breaks down from heat and humidity. Toyota offered a warranty enhancement program to replace affected dashboards on certain cars.
issues.next: Ask a Toyota dealer to check your VIN for the dashboard program. A dash cover cuts glare in the meantime.

issues.t: Steering shaft joint may not be welded (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. Play or clunking in the steering could appear before the joint separates.
issues.why: On some cars a steering yoke was not welded to its shaft at the factory, so it could come apart and cause a loss of steering. Toyota recalled the cars to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it done. Stop driving if the steering feels loose or clunks.

issues.t: Airbag inflators may not fully inflate (recall)
issues.sym: No warning to the driver.
issues.why: Some airbag inflators were assembled without enough of the material that heats the gas, so the bag might not fill completely in a crash. Toyota recalled the cars to replace them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the airbag replaced if it was never done.

issues.t: Brake master cylinder seal can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A brake warning light, a low brake fluid level, or a pedal that sinks further than normal.
issues.why: Brake fluid used during some service work lacked an additive that keeps a master cylinder seal soft. The seal could dry out and leak. Toyota recalled the cars to inspect and fix them.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Do not drive if the brake light is on or the pedal sinks; have it towed.

issues.t: Accelerator pedal can stick (recalls)
issues.sym: The gas pedal is slow to return, feels sticky, or stays partly pressed, or it gets caught on the floor mat.
issues.why: Toyota recalled these cars twice: once because a loose or wrong floor mat could trap the pedal, and once because the pedal itself could develop friction and stick.
issues.next: If the pedal sticks, shift to Neutral, brake firmly and pull over. Check the VIN for both recalls and use only a secured mat made for the car.

issues.t: Seat heater wiring can short and burn (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell from the seat, a seat heater that stops working, or a seat that gets too hot.
issues.why: A heavily compressed seat cushion could damage the seat heater wiring and cause a short that can burn the occupant. Toyota recalled the cars to repair the seats.
issues.next: Turn off the seat heater and check the VIN for this recall. Stop using it if you smell burning.

issues.t: Trunk subwoofer can short and overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell from the trunk, crackling or a dead audio system.
issues.why: The subwoofer in the trunk could short and damage the audio amplifier, which could overheat and start a fire. Toyota recalled the cars to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If you smell burning from the trunk, turn the audio off and get it repaired.

issues.t: A/C water can drip onto the airbag computer (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag light comes on, power steering assist may cut out, or there is damp carpet near the center console.
issues.why: A clogged A/C drain could let water drip onto the airbag control module and short it, which can disable the airbags and the electric power steering. Toyota recalled the cars to fix the drain and protect the module.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it done. Get the car checked right away if the airbag light is on or the steering gets heavy.

issues.t: Airbag control unit may fail in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning beforehand.
issues.why: Electrical noise during some crashes could damage the airbag control unit, so the airbags and seat belt pretensioners may not work. Toyota recalled the cars to add a protective part.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get the free repair.

issues.t: Windshield wipers can stop working (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers quit or act erratically, often in heavy use.
issues.why: The wiper switch could short internally and cut power to the wipers. Toyota recalled the cars to replace the switch.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Do not drive in rain or snow until the wipers work properly.

issues.t: Pre-collision system can brake for no reason (recall)
issues.sym: The car brakes hard on its own, for example when driving over a steel plate in the road.
issues.why: The radar-based pre-collision system could mistake a steel road plate or joint for an obstacle and apply the brakes. Toyota recalled the cars to update the software.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get the update. Until then, watch for traffic behind you on roads with metal plates.

issues.t: Left front lower control arm can separate (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the left front, or a car that pulls or wanders.
issues.why: The lower control arm may not grip the ball joint tightly enough, so the two could separate and cause a loss of control. Toyota recalled the cars to replace the arm.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Stop driving and have it towed if the front end clunks or pulls.

issues.t: Fuel delivery pipe can leak (recall)
issues.sym: A raw fuel smell under the hood or near the car.
issues.why: A fuel pipe in the engine bay could leak, which creates a fire risk. Toyota recalled the cars to fix it.
issues.next: Do not drive if you smell fuel. Check the VIN for this recall and get it repaired.

issues.t: Passenger airbag sensing may be off (recalls)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light may show the wrong state for who is in the seat.
issues.why: The front passenger occupant sensor could be calibrated wrong, and on some cars the knee airbag was attached with the wrong fasteners. Either could keep an airbag from working as intended. Toyota recalled the cars.
issues.next: Check the VIN for these recalls and have them done.

issues.t: Hybrid check engine light for generator inverter fault
issues.sym: A check engine light and hybrid warning, sometimes with reduced power.
issues.why: Toyota issued a service bulletin for a stored generator inverter fault code on the Avalon Hybrid and related hybrids.
issues.next: Have a Toyota dealer read the codes and apply the bulletin. Avoid long trips until it is checked.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Rough running, warning lights, stalling while driving, or a car that will not start.
issues.why: The low-pressure fuel pump in the tank could stop working. Toyota recalled the cars to install an improved pump.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get the free repair. Stop driving if the engine starts stumbling or losing power.

issues.t: Airbag computer may switch off airbags at startup (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light may come on after starting the car.
issues.why: The airbag control unit could falsely detect a fault at startup and disable the airbags. Toyota recalled the cars to fix it.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it repaired. Get the airbag light checked if it stays on.

issues.t: Misfire codes and check engine light
issues.sym: A check engine light with misfire codes, sometimes with a rough idle.
issues.why: Toyota issued a service bulletin for misfire-related trouble codes on this engine.
issues.next: Have a dealer read the codes and apply the bulletin. A flashing check engine light means stop driving.

issues.t: Torque converter lock-up fault with check engine light
issues.sym: A check engine light, sometimes with a shudder or odd feel at steady cruising speed.
issues.why: Toyota issued a service bulletin for a flex lock-up concern in the automatic transmission.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check the codes and the bulletin for your VIN.

issues.t: Knocking from the brake vacuum pump at idle
issues.sym: A knock or tapping from the engine at idle.
issues.why: The engine-driven vacuum pump that helps the brakes can make noise. Toyota issued a service bulletin for it.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the noise source and apply the bulletin.

issues.t: Front shock absorber noise over bumps
issues.sym: A knock or clunk from the front over bumps.
issues.why: Toyota issued a service bulletin for noise traced to the front shock absorbers.
issues.next: Have a dealer check the shocks and the bulletin.

issues.t: Airbag-related recalls (steering column and passenger sensor)
issues.sym: Usually no warning. The passenger airbag light may show the wrong status.
issues.why: Toyota recalled these cars because steering column breakaway pins could be damaged in production, affecting the driver airbag, and because the passenger seat sensor could short so the passenger airbag might not deploy.
issues.next: Check the VIN for both recalls and get the free repairs.
